#kendall correlation analysis
```{r}
name_map <- c(
  azimuth           = "Azimuth_MMC",
  pbmc              = "PBMC",
  pollen            = "Pollen.",
  subsetbraindata   = "Human_Primary_Motor_Cortex",
  tabulamurisliver  = "Tabula Muris Liver",
  tabulamurislung   = "Tabula Muris Lung"
)

datasets <- names(name_map)

results_list <- lapply(datasets, function(nm) {
  obj <- get(nm)
  
  test <- cor.test(obj$PPS_rank, obj$HVG_rank, method = "kendall")
  
  data.frame(
    dataset_name = name_map[[nm]],
    tau = unname(test$estimate),
    pvalue = test$p.value
  )
})

kendall_results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
kendall_results

write.csv(kendall_results, paste0(here(), "/Statistical_Tests/Kendall_Correlation.csv"))
```

#read in counts and perform HVG
```{r read-in-counts}
library(Seurat)

#AZIMUTH
azimuth_count <- read.csv(paste0(here(), "/Filtered_Input/Azimuth_filtereddatQC_basicQC_LibraryIDs.csv"), row.names = 1)
rownames(azimuth_count) <- gsub("-", "_", rownames(azimuth_count))
colnames(azimuth_count) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(azimuth_count))

seuratObject<- CreateSeuratObject(counts = as.matrix(azimuth_count))
Idents(seuratObject) <- "All_Cells"
norm_seuratObject <- NormalizeData(seuratObject)
seuratObject<- FindVariableFeatures(norm_seuratObject, selection.method = "dispersion", nfeatures = length(row.names(azimuth_count)))
HVGs <- VariableFeatures(seuratObject)
HVGs<-gsub("-", "_", HVGs)
azimuth_hvgs<-HVGs[1:100]

#PBMC
pbmc_count <- read.csv(paste0(here(), "/Filtered_Input/PBMCs10xfromSC1.csv"), row.names = 1)
rownames(pbmc_count) <- gsub("-", "_", rownames(pbmc_count))
colnames(pbmc_count) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(pbmc_count))

seuratObject<- CreateSeuratObject(counts = as.matrix(pbmc_count))
norm_seuratObject <- NormalizeData(seuratObject)
seuratObject<- FindVariableFeatures(norm_seuratObject, selection.method = "dispersion", nfeatures = length(row.names(pbmc_count)))
HVGs <- VariableFeatures(seuratObject)
HVGs<-gsub("-", "_", HVGs)
pbmc_hvgs<-HVGs[1:100]

#POLLEN
pollen_count <- read.csv(paste0(here(), "/Filtered_Input/Pollen_TPM_Matrix.csv"), row.names = 1)
rownames(pollen_count) <- gsub("-", "_", rownames(pollen_count))
colnames(pollen_count) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(pollen_count))

pollen_seuratObject <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = as.matrix(pollen_count))
norm_pollen_seuratObject <- NormalizeData(pollen_seuratObject)
pollen_seuratObject <- FindVariableFeatures(norm_pollen_seuratObject, selection.method = "dispersion", nfeatures = length(row.names(pollen_count)))
pollen_HVGs <- VariableFeatures(pollen_seuratObject)
pollen_HVGs <- gsub("-", "_", pollen_HVGs)
pollen_hvgs <- pollen_HVGs[1:100]

#BRAIN
brain_count <- read.csv(paste0(here(), "/Filtered_Input/Human_Primary_Motor_Cortex.csv"), row.names = 1)
rownames(brain_count) <- gsub("-", "_", rownames(brain_count))
colnames(brain_count) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(brain_count))

brain_seuratObject <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = as.matrix(brain_count))
norm_brain_seuratObject <- NormalizeData(brain_seuratObject)
brain_seuratObject <- FindVariableFeatures(norm_brain_seuratObject, selection.method = "dispersion", nfeatures = length(row.names(brain_count)))
brain_HVGs <- VariableFeatures(brain_seuratObject)
brain_HVGs <- gsub("-", "_", brain_HVGs)
brain_hvgs <- brain_HVGs[1:100]

#LIVER 
liver_count <- read.csv(paste0(here(), "/Filtered_Input/TabulaMuris_Liver_Counts.csv"), row.names = 1)
rownames(liver_count) <- gsub("-", "_", rownames(liver_count))
colnames(liver_count) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(liver_count))

liver_seuratObject <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = as.matrix(liver_count))
norm_liver_seuratObject <- NormalizeData(liver_seuratObject)
liver_seuratObject <- FindVariableFeatures(norm_liver_seuratObject, selection.method = "dispersion", nfeatures = length(row.names(liver_count)))
liver_HVGs <- VariableFeatures(liver_seuratObject)
liver_HVGs <- gsub("-", "_", liver_HVGs)
liver_hvgs <- liver_HVGs[1:100]

#LUNG
lung_count <- read.csv(paste0(here(), "/Filtered_Input/TabulaMuris_Lung_Counts.csv"), row.names = 1)
rownames(lung_count) <- gsub("-", "_", rownames(lung_count))
colnames(lung_count) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(lung_count))
```

#expression and variance boxplots
```{r expression-boxplots}
library(ggplot2)

#compute mean expression & variance for a gene set in a given count matrix
get_gene_stats <- function(genes, count_matrix) {
  count_matrix<-log2(count_matrix + 1)
  genes <- gsub("-", "_", genes)              # match naming convention used on count matrices
  genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(count_matrix))
  mat <- count_matrix[genes, , drop = FALSE]
  data.frame(
    gene = genes,
    mean_expression = rowMeans(mat),
    variance = apply(mat, 1, var)
  )
}

# Principal Genes (top 100 PPS-ranked genes)
azimuth_pg <- get_gene_stats(rownames(azimuth), azimuth_count)
azimuth_pg$dataset <- "Azimuth_MMC"

pbmc_pg <- get_gene_stats(rownames(pbmc), pbmc_count)
pbmc_pg$dataset <- "PBMC"

pollen_pg <- get_gene_stats(rownames(pollen), pollen_count)
pollen_pg$dataset <- "Pollen"

brain_pg <- get_gene_stats(rownames(subsetbraindata), brain_count)
brain_pg$dataset <- "Human Primary Motor Cortex"

liver_pg <- get_gene_stats(rownames(tabulamurisliver), liver_count)
liver_pg$dataset <- "Tabula Muris Liver"

lung_pg <- get_gene_stats(rownames(tabulamurislung), lung_count)
lung_pg$dataset <- "Tabula Muris Lung"

principal_genes_df <- do.call(rbind, list(azimuth_pg, pbmc_pg, pollen_pg, brain_pg, liver_pg, lung_pg))
principal_genes_df$Category <- "Principal Genes"

#HVGs (top 100 by dispersion)
azimuth_hvg <- get_gene_stats(azimuth_hvgs, azimuth_count)
azimuth_hvg$dataset <- "Azimuth_MMC"

pbmc_hvg <- get_gene_stats(pbmc_hvgs, pbmc_count)
pbmc_hvg$dataset <- "PBMC"

pollen_hvg <- get_gene_stats(pollen_hvgs, pollen_count)
pollen_hvg$dataset <- "Pollen"

brain_hvg <- get_gene_stats(brain_hvgs, brain_count)
brain_hvg$dataset <- "Human Primary Motor Cortex"

liver_hvg <- get_gene_stats(liver_hvgs, liver_count)
liver_hvg$dataset <- "Tabula Muris Liver"

lung_hvg <- get_gene_stats(lung_hvgs, lung_count)
lung_hvg$dataset <- "Tabula Muris Lung"

hvg_genes_df <- do.call(rbind, list(azimuth_hvg, pbmc_hvg, pollen_hvg, brain_hvg, liver_hvg, lung_hvg))
hvg_genes_df$Category <- "HVGs"

#Combine & plot
expression_boxplot_df <- rbind(principal_genes_df, hvg_genes_df)
expression_boxplot_df$Category <- factor(expression_boxplot_df$Category,
                                          levels = c("Principal Genes", "HVGs"))

gene_set_cols <- c("Principal Genes" = "#1BB7D8",
                   "HVGs"            = "#E55B1E")

ggplot(expression_boxplot_df, aes(x = Category, y = mean_expression, fill = Category)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = gene_set_cols) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave(filename = paste0(here(), "/Statistical_Tests/Log2v2Mean_Expression_HVG_vs_PG_boxplot_bydataset.jpg"),
       dpi = 300, width = 10, height = 7)

ggplot(expression_boxplot_df, aes(x = Category, y = variance, fill = Category)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = gene_set_cols) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave(filename = paste0(here(), "/Statistical_Tests/Log2v2Variance_HVG_vs_PG_boxplot_bydataset.jpg"),
       dpi = 300, width = 10, height = 7)

expression_boxplot_df$gene<-NULL
write.csv(expression_boxplot_df, paste0(here(), "/Statistical_Tests/log2_mean_expression_variance_all_datasets.csv"))
```
